main: (seq (set source (first in)) (while (!= source -1) (seq (split source 0) (set source (next in source)))) (set obj (first out)) (while (!= obj -1) (seq (u0001 obj) (set obj (next out obj)))))
explanation: Each coloured seed extends vertically downward to the bottom edge, preserving its colour and column. Splitting the multicolour input object isolates the seeds before extension. Assumes each single-colour component is a seed and downward extensions do not conflict.
